baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعلنا الليل والنهار آيتين / محونا آية الليل / جعلنا آية النهار مبصرة
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired signs are made functionally unequal: one is marked by loss of trace, while the other is placed into a sight-enabling condition. Their asymmetry, not bare alternation, carries the sign.

activation_trace.role: Making as placing something into a condition supplies the deliberate asymmetry assigned to the two signs.
A manifest mark supplies the common sign-status that survives the pair's unequal treatment.
Loss of a trace supplies subtraction as the night sign's positive functional feature.
Eyesight supplies the day sign's contrasting capacity to disclose and enable visual action.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are two generic natural signs.
changed_reading.after: Their engineered difference, trace-withdrawal versus sight-enabling disclosure, is itself the sign system.

baseline_models.mechanism: Alternating darkness and opened daylight establish recurrent boundaries; recurrence turns duration into countable years and supports reckoning beyond mere visual recognition.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness opposed to day supplies one recurring pole of the temporal measure.
Daylight opening supplies the other bounded pole by which cycles become perceptible.
A fixed time that recurs supplies the conversion of alternation into calendrical units.
The year as a temporal span supplies the larger unit accumulated from recurrent days.
Counting, calculation, and estimation supply the operation performed on those units.
Separating things until a boundary appears supplies the segmentation required for reliable count.

changed_reading.before: The alternation helps people tell time.
changed_reading.after: The differentiated cycle is public measurement infrastructure: boundaries generate countable years and reckonable relations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مبصرة لتبتغوا فضلا من ربكم ولتعلموا
baseline_models.mechanism: Daylight enables directed seeking of an unowed gift, while the same ordered environment enables knowledge. Material pursuit and disciplined knowing are coordinated under continuing lordly nurture.

activation_trace.role: Visual perception supplies the practical condition for movement and search.
Directed seeking supplies the human action made possible by the visible day.
A freely given benefit supplies the sought provision without reducing it to wages mechanically earned.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the sustaining relation behind both provision and learning.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic outcome of the ordered cycle.

changed_reading.before: Day is for work, and the cycle also provides a calendar.
changed_reading.after: One environmental rhythm coordinates sustenance-seeking and epistemic discipline within an ongoing relation of nurture.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing universalization recapitulates the ayah's own method: wholes become legible when their parts and limits are separated and then articulated.

activation_trace.role: Totality formed by encompassing parts supplies the whole that requires articulation.
Anything knowable and reportable supplies the unrestricted domain of the legibility claim.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies the method by which a whole becomes discriminable.
Detailing that distinguishes parts and meanings supplies the explanatory completion of that method.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes by saying that everything has been explained.
changed_reading.after: The close states a method of knowledge: reality becomes legible through bounded distinctions, as the night-day pair demonstrates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening night journey occurs for the showing of signs and closes with seeing. This prevents the focus's erasure from meaning that night itself is meaningless; what is withdrawn is a mode of visible manifestation, while night remains a medium of movement and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Erasure as loss of trace supplies the feature that must be delimited rather than expanded into total insignificance.
Night travel supplies purposeful movement within the supposedly effaced temporal domain.
Undertaking an activity at night supplies night as an operative medium rather than an empty interval.
Showing and making visible supplies an active disclosure occurring inside the night journey.
Manifest signs supply the disclosed content encountered through that nocturnal movement.
Sight supplies the perceptual closure of a sequence in which darkness does not cancel disclosure.

structural_cues: 17:1 places night travel, the showing of signs, and seeing in one clause chain.
17:12 erases the sign of night, not the noun night itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nocturnal movement, displayed signs, and seeing; I infer that erasure removes one mode of manifestation rather than night's capacity to signify. A live alternative is the narrower removal of nocturnal luminosity.

changed_reading.before: The night side is the low-visibility member whose sign is erased.
changed_reading.after: Night is negatively marked yet still operational and revelatory; concealment and disclosure are alternating modes of signification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence counts repeated episodes, appoints their times, restores a turn, and makes return answer return. The focus's calendar therefore also frames moral history as recurrent, conditional feedback rather than homogeneous elapsed time.

activation_trace.role: A fixed recurrent time supplies the focus's measurable temporal frame.
Calculation supplies the operation by which repeated episodes can be compared and reckoned.
A temporal occurrence and its repetition supply explicitly counted historical recurrence.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies scheduled realization rather than accidental sequence.
Return and repetition after an earlier occurrence supply reversal as a new historical turn.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supply the conditional feedback rule: return answers return.

structural_cues: 17:4-8 orders twice, the first appointment, a restored turn, the later appointment, and reciprocal return.
The calendrical focus follows this recurrent history rather than appearing in an isolated cosmological block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numbered recurrences, appointed realization, restored turns, and reciprocal return; I infer that the night-day count also models historical feedback. A live alternative is that the historical and cosmic cycles merely resonate without sharing a mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night and day form a physical calendar.
changed_reading.after: The calendar also makes patterned history reckonable: recurrence can carry consequence, reversal, and renewed opportunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human haste immediately precedes the focus and reappears as desire for the immediate afterward. Count, reckoning, and detailed separation answer that compression by forcing good and evil, immediate and later, into distinguishable temporal horizons.

activation_trace.role: Enumerating what is counted supplies deliberate pacing against premature collapse.
Calculation and estimation supply reflective judgment across time.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the discrimination haste bypasses.
Speed and premature advancement supply the human tendency placed directly before the measured cycle.
Hastening and privileging the immediate supply the later temporal distortion that measured distinction corrects.

structural_cues: 17:11's hasty human is followed immediately by 17:12's count and reckoning.
17:18 reactivates the same root in the contrast between the immediate and the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste before the focus and pursuit of the immediate after it; I infer that the intervening temporal apparatus is corrective pedagogy. A live alternative is a descriptive juxtaposition with no intended therapeutic arrow.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers neutral chronological knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Temporal literacy disciplines haste by keeping unlike goods, consequences, and horizons from being treated as immediately interchangeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's count and account become the outer analogue of a record bound to each person, brought out as writing, spread open, read, and self-reckoned. Cosmic order and personal accountability share an architecture of durable legibility.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting supply the operation that links public time to personal reckoning.
Detailed articulation supplies the record's requirement that acts remain distinguishable and readable.
Binding and affixing by judgment supply the durable attachment of account to its person.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the account's externalized, inspectable form.
A written record laid open supplies disclosure of what had been accumulated.
Reading and recitation supply personal access to the disclosed record.
Reckoning supplies the explicit transfer from a cosmic calculation term to self-accounting.

structural_cues: 17:12's universal detailing is followed by every person, an attached record, and an opened book in 17:13.
17:14 converts the written disclosure into second-person reading and self-reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic count followed by an attached, opened, read, and self-reckoned record; I infer one legibility architecture, not that day and night mechanically write deeds. A live alternative is a rhetorical analogy between two independent kinds of account.

changed_reading.before: The account is calendrical and mathematical.
changed_reading.after: The public ledger of time anticipates a personal ledger in which differentiated acts remain attached, exposable, and self-readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Detailed separation becomes a condition of justice: each self receives its own trajectory, one heavy burden is not transferred to another, and punishment is separated from the period before a message. Distinction prevents moral conflation.

activation_trace.role: Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies a juridical force to the focus's detailing.
The thing's own self and identity supply the irreducible unit to which guidance or loss returns.
A heavy carried burden supplies the load explicitly barred from transfer between persons.
A messenger and message supply notice as a distinct stage before punitive consequence.

structural_cues: 17:15 repeatedly distributes guidance and loss to the self, then negates burden transfer.
The verse also places message before punishment, preserving a temporal boundary within judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-specific outcomes, nontransferable burden, and notice before punishment; I infer that the focus's detailing includes procedural individuation. A live alternative is that تفصيل remains a generic explanatory close with no juridical extension.

changed_reading.before: Everything is separated and explained clearly.
changed_reading.after: Detail is also justice: selves, burdens, notices, and consequences are kept from being improperly merged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sought فضل is reframed by the later extension of the Lord's giving to both orientations without being barred. Daytime access to provision is real divine bounty, but possession of it does not itself certify the seeker's moral standing.

activation_trace.role: Directed seeking supplies the human pursuit whose moral meaning remains open.
A freely given benefit supplies bounty without making receipt equivalent to desert.
All-encompassing totality supplies inclusion of both previously contrasted orientations.
A connected increase that sustains another supplies ongoing extension to both groups.
Handing over and giving supply the explicit gift-character of the provision.
Lordship and ownership supply the same giver relation named in the focus.
Barring and withholding supply the restriction explicitly negated from the Lord's gift.

structural_cues: 17:18-20 contrasts two temporal orientations and then says both are extended from the Lord's gift.
17:20 repeats رب from the focus and negates restriction on the giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both groups, sustained extension, gift from the Lord, and negated restriction; I infer that focus فضل names access to provision rather than a verdict on the recipient. A live alternative is that فضل in 17:12 has a narrower morally marked sense than the later عطا.

changed_reading.before: Visible day lets people seek the Lord's bounty.
changed_reading.after: That bounty is broadly accessible across divergent orientations, so economic receipt cannot serve as a moral certificate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to look compares parts, ranks them by degrees, and repeats فضل. This makes the focus's distinct roots فضل and فصل conceptually cooperate: articulated differences render unequal allotments and grades visible, without claiming that the roots are identical.

activation_trace.role: Degree and comparative excellence supply the possibility that bounty appears as differential rank.
Distinguishing parts and meanings supplies the articulation that makes gradients inspectable.
Directing sight or insight supplies the required act of comparative inspection.
Preference and degree supply the repeated comparative axis applied across persons and horizons.
Partition into some parts rather than others supplies the units being compared.
Taking something degree by degree supplies an ordered gradient rather than a flat binary.

structural_cues: The focus places فضل and فصل in one ayah while keeping them morphologically distinct.
17:21 orders looking, part-to-part comparison, degrees, and repeated تفضيل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparison, partition, degrees, and repeated فضل; I infer conceptual cooperation between فضل and فصل, not derivational identity. A live alternative is that the two roots remain independent and only converge at the level of the passage's topic.

changed_reading.before: Detailed articulation makes the world's binary distinctions understandable.
changed_reading.after: Articulation also exposes gradients: count and comparison make differential allotments and ranks visible across temporal horizons.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads repeated جعل ethically across unlike objects. It remains anchored in the focus's two جعل occurrences and 17:22's same construction, where making a rival is followed by inactivity and abandonment. Render it only as a possible contrast in assigned order, not as proof that the verses form a formal pair.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جعلنا الليل والنهار / جعلنا آية النهار

activation_trace.role: Placing things into distinct conditions supplies legitimate ordering in the focus.
Placing something into a status supplies the human counter-case of assigning rival divinity.
Worship and the object worshipped supply the illicit status assigned by that making.
Sitting back from action supplies immobilization as the result of disordered assignment.
Separation from one's company supplies the stranded condition that follows the false placement.

changed_reading.before: The focus's making is exclusively a cosmological act.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic making may also establish an ethical grammar: proper assignment enables life and knowledge, while false assignment disorders agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily weaning branch of فصل for abstract تفصيل. It remains anchored in the focus root, the nurturing رب relation, and the following move to a self-bound, nontransferable account. Render it as a maturation analogy only, never as the lexical sense demanded by the form.

activation_trace.role: A young one separated from mother or nursing supplies the exploratory image of maturation through separation.
Nurture through successive completion supplies the prior relation from which mature agency can emerge.
A judgment affixed to its bearer supplies the transition to personally attached consequence.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies the mature unit responsible for its trajectory.
A heavy carried burden supplies responsibility that cannot be transferred back onto another bearer.

changed_reading.before: Detailing separates conceptual parts for understanding.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, separation also resembles maturation from nurture into self-accounting and nontransferable responsibility.

strongest_changes: 17:1 prevents the erased night sign from becoming meaningless night: nocturnal concealment still carries movement and disclosed signs.
17:11 and 17:18 turn count, account, and detail into a discipline against haste and fixation on the immediate.
17:13-15 extend cosmic legibility into an attached, readable, self-reckoned, and nontransferable personal account.
17:20-21 separate broadly available bounty from moral rank, then make differentiation visible as comparison by degrees.
summary.what_was_special: The focus fuses cosmology, economy, epistemology, and accountability through one mechanism of bounded difference; the context changes what erasure, counting, bounty, and detail are doing without collapsing the coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether محونا آية الليل denotes removed luminosity, reduced visibility, or a broader negative marking remains open.
The mapping from astronomical recurrence to historical feedback and personal record may be structural analogy rather than a single causal system.
The conceptual cooperation of distinct roots فضل and فصل in 17:21 may be deliberate passage-level patterning or only contextual convergence.
